comparison_summary.conclusion: Phase 4 attempted to surpass the tabular machine learning models (KNN/XGBoost/OMP) by utilizing natively sequential Deep Learning architecture (PyTorch LSTM). The rigorous Time-Series cross-validation reveals that the LSTM heavily underperformed across all sectors (e.g., scoring 151 on Residential vs KNN's 67, and 75 on Industrial vs XGBoost's 62). This mathematically confirms the hypothesis: Neural Networks require thousands of data points to overcome extreme overfitting. With only ~600 months of data, the Phase 2 architecture (Tree Ensembles + Fourier Lags) officially remains the Champion architecture, representing the absolute maximum signal extraction possible from this dataset.

phase4_deep_learning.notes: Severe Overfitting (CV Training Loss near zero, Validation Loss exploded)
Deep learning failed to capture the rigid heating/cooling frequency spikes without explicit Fourier features.
LSTM completely failed to track the pandemic-era structural break, causing massive error deviation.
